description: VERUS_SQL_COVERAGE task A: MIN/MAX over int4, int8, numeric, date, timestamp, text, varchar and char(n) (NULLs ignored; empty and all-NULL input give NULL; group 2 is all-NULL), extrema over equal numerics of different display scales (COALESCE of numeric(6,1) and numeric(6,2); the displayed representative is plan-dependent, R1/D2: value-only columns), and COUNT/SUM/AVG(DISTINCT) with NULLs and with 1.0/1.00 duplicates; MIN/MAX(DISTINCT).

ddl.sql: CREATE TABLE m (id integer NOT NULL, g integer NOT NULL, i integer, b bigint, n numeric(10,2), p numeric(6,1), q numeric(6,2), d date, ts timestamp, s text, v varchar(8), c char(4), f boolean);

cases.name: minmax_typed_groups
cases.sql: SELECT g, MIN(i) AS min_i, MAX(i) AS max_i, MIN(b) AS min_b, MAX(b) AS max_b, MIN(n) AS min_n, MAX(n) AS max_n, MIN(d) AS min_d, MAX(d) AS max_d, MIN(ts) AS min_ts, MAX(ts) AS max_ts, MIN(s) AS min_s, MAX(s) AS max_s, MIN(v) AS min_v, MAX(v) AS max_v, MIN(c) AS min_c, MAX(c) AS max_c FROM m GROUP BY g
cases.note: group 2 is all-NULL: every extremum is NULL; text in C collation ('B' < 'ab' < 'b')

cases.name: empty_input
cases.sql: SELECT MIN(i) AS a, MAX(ts) AS b, MIN(s) AS c, MAX(n) AS d, COUNT(DISTINCT i) AS e, SUM(DISTINCT n) AS f, AVG(DISTINCT i) AS h FROM m WHERE g = 99
cases.note: no input row: one row, NULL extrema, COUNT(DISTINCT) 0

cases.name: minmax_mixed_scale
cases.sql: SELECT g, MIN(COALESCE(p, q)) AS lo, MAX(COALESCE(p, q)) AS hi FROM m GROUP BY g
cases.note: group 1 values 1.0, 1.00, 3.00, 3.0: equal extremes of different scales (Verus keeps the first, R1)

cases.name: distinct_mixed_scale
cases.sql: SELECT g, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(p, q)) AS k, SUM(DISTINCT COALESCE(p, q)) AS s, AVG(DISTINCT COALESCE(p, q)) AS a FROM m GROUP BY g
cases.note: 1.0 and 1.00 (and 3.00 and 3.0) are one DISTINCT value each

cases.name: distinct_with_nulls
cases.sql: SELECT g, COUNT(DISTINCT i) AS ci, COUNT(i) AS ni, SUM(DISTINCT i) AS si, SUM(DISTINCT b) AS sb, AVG(DISTINCT n) AS an, COUNT(DISTINCT s) AS cs, SUM(DISTINCT n) AS sn FROM m GROUP BY g
cases.note: NULLs are not counted; duplicates removed before COUNT/SUM/AVG

cases.name: minmax_distinct_normalized
cases.sql: SELECT MIN(DISTINCT n) AS a, MAX(DISTINCT s) AS b, MAX(DISTINCT ts) AS c FROM m

cases.name: minmax_having
cases.sql: SELECT g, MAX(ts) AS last_ts FROM m GROUP BY g HAVING MIN(d) > DATE '2023-01-01'
cases.note: group 2 (MIN NULL) and group 3 are filtered out

cases.name: minmax_untyped_literal
cases.sql: SELECT MIN('b') AS a, MAX(NULL) AS b FROM m WHERE g = 1
cases.note: an untyped literal resolves to min(text)
